description: Files the harness assets name but a consuming repository owns. The harness never ships or installs these; it links to them because a skill or an agent tells the model to consult the consumer's own guidance. A bare harness checkout therefore cannot resolve them. tools/validate_harness.py resolves them against generated placeholders so the validator runs unmodified, and tests/test_consumer_paths.py fails if any asset depends on a path that is not declared here.
